bio: Chris L. Beck (born May 29, 1963) is an American politician who served in the Oregon House of Representatives from 1997 to 2003, representing the 12th district. A member of the Democratic Party, he is a candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in Oregon's 2nd congressional district in the 2026 elections.
offices: Member of the Oregon House of Representatives (1997–2003)
